name: Brave Romantic (Battle Herald)
body:
Rather than inspiring an army by leading it with tactics, a brave romantic rushes in first lines inspiring allies by example with her daring deeds.

Requirements

To qualify to become a brave romantic, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Base Attack Bonus: +4.
Special: Charmed life and inspire courage class features.
Skills: Diplomacy 5 ranks, Intimidate 5 ranks, Perform (oratory) 5 ranks, Profession (soldier) 2 ranks.

This alters requirements.

Features
Class Skills

The brave romantic gains Acrobatics as a class skill in place of Handle Animal.

This alters class skills.

Deed of Performance (Ex)

The brave romantic can spend inspiring command rounds interchangeably with panache points to use both her inspiring commands and swashbuckler deeds. Having rounds of inspiring command left to use is not considered as having at least 1 point in her panache pool for the purpose of using deeds.

This replaces voice of authority.

Nimble (Ex)

At 5th level, the brave romantic gains the swashbuckler’s nimble ability. Her class levels stack with her swashbuckler levels to determine her AC bonus.

This replaces banner.

Commanding Panache

At 6th level, the brave romantic’s panache bolsters her inspiring commands. As an immediate action, the brave romantic can expend 1 panache point to add +1 to her inspiring command bonus for a number of rounds equal to her Charisma modifier.

This replaces teamwork feat.

Inspire Deeds

At 7th level, the brave romantic can use her inspiring command ability to grant her allies one 1stlevel swashbuckler deed she possesses. Affected allies use the brave romantic’s ability scores to determine the deed’s effects.

This replaces demanding challenge.
